profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a for-profit technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington, founded in 1975 and publicly traded under the ticker MSFT. As of June 30, 2026, the company reported revenue of $331,839,000,000. According to its website, Microsoft describes Power Automate as a platform for automating workflows and business processes across applications, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. The company highlights use cases where generative AI and Power Automate have reduced manual labor requirements, such as data validation processes that formerly required over 100 people now managed by a few.

Microsoft's AI product portfolio spans multiple categories. In automation and agents, it offers Microsoft Power Automate AI with Copilot integration and data loss prevention capabilities. The company provides chat and general LLM services through Microsoft Copilot, embedded across Microsoft 365. Cloud AI services include Azure Machine Learning (an MLOps platform with AutoML and model registry) and Azure OpenAI Service, which delivers OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering and data residency controls. Developer tools include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, and the Semantic Kernel SDK for model-agnostic orchestration, which the held facts note will be superseded by the Microsoft Agent Framework in 2026. Additional products span image generation through Microsoft Designer, meeting and collaboration features via Teams AI and SharePoint AI, and video editing through Microsoft Clipchamp AI.

Microsoft is named as a defendant in two copyright infringement lawsuits filed in U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. The company holds 96 registered patents or lawsuits related to Washington state.
